summary: CID Holdco, Inc. (DAIC) filed an 8-K disclosing a series of financing agreements with White Lion Capital, LLC, including a $10M Common Stock Purchase Agreement (equity line/facility), a convertible note, and a warrant. The CSPA allows CID Holdco to sell up to $10M of common stock at the company's discretion through rapid purchase or VWAP mechanisms during a commitment period ending December 2028. No price per share, premium, or special-situation M&A event is provided. This is a routine equity financing facility, not a corporate special situation like an acquisition, tender, or restructuring.
